rationale: Align task review recipes with the common-ancestor task context and distinguish incoming reference changes from authored deletions. Preserve real deletions, direct ship/release ranges, historical verdicts and all publication/merge/execution guards.

summary.ru: Ревью отличает входящие документы dev от удалений в самой задаче и явно показывает базу сравнения.
summary.en: Task review distinguishes incoming dev documents from task deletions and explicitly identifies the comparison basis.
